observations: Three photos show a dark gray laptop with a touchscreen, open at a typical typing angle.
The screen displays a Windows desktop with a scenic wallpaper, taskbar visible, and icons including the Start menu and File Explorer.
The keyboard is black with white lettering, and the touchpad is large and centered below the keyboard.
The laptop has a 360-degree hinge, visible in all photos, allowing the screen to fold back over the keyboard — consistent with a 2-in-1 design.
The device appears to be in a retail or storage environment, with stacks of plastic-wrapped items in the background.
No visible branding on the keyboard, screen bezel, or chassis in any photo.
No model number, serial number, or Dell logo is visible in any photo.
The screen is on and responsive in all photos, suggesting it is powered on and functional at the time of shooting.

The hinge allows the screen to rotate 360 degrees, visible in all photos.
